events.title: Sunmi Han, piano
events.description: While solo repertoire remains an important part of her artistic identity, chamber music and collaboration are central to Han’s work. She believes chamber music is where friendships form, stories intertwine, and listening becomes an act of generosity. Through her work as both a performer and educator, she is passionate about creating musical communities where artists grow not only in skill, but also in humanity.

events.title: Tunes on Tuesday: Piotr Kozłowski, Part 1
events.description: Polish pianist and educator Piotr Kozłowski presents the first of his two-part session: Central European Music & Culture . Join Piotr for a closer look at the rich musical traditions of Central Europe, exploring the composers, cultural influences, and history that have shaped the region's classical music.

events.title: First of Bells - Encore Performance
events.description: First of Bells reimagines the music of Cape Breton songwriters, tunesmiths, and musicians. The trio, consisting of guitar, bass, and drums, explores a golden era in Cape Breton music with fresh instrumental jazz interpretations of the Rankin Family, Rita MacNeil, Winston Scotty Fitzgerald, Don Palmer, and more. Just as jazz musicians have reinterpreted the music of artists like Bob Dylan, the Beatles, or Radiohead, First of Bells pays homage to Cape Breton musicians, whose impact has been just as significant to those raised here.

events.title: Ellita Gagner, mezzo-soprano
events.description: Canadian mezzo-soprano Ellita Gagner , currently based in Montreal, has been praised for her “gorgeous, warm tone and winning gamine personality.” She has performed leading and supporting roles across Canada with companies and ensembles including Opéra de Montréal, Opera Nova Scotia, the Brott Festival, Maritime Concert Opera, and Chorus Niagara.
